name: Lockpicks
description: A roll of picks and a tension wrench. Legally, a set of very small dental instruments.
notes: A roll of picks and a tension wrench on the tool belt: the thief can pick locks while carrying them (tool.lockpick, ADR-0004). Breaking or losing them takes the verb away. Grey-box starting kit item (mw-e19.4); tuned with the final kits in m2/m3.
